title: Configuration loading
description: A small demo for synchronized source annotations.

annotations.title: Read environment values at the edge
annotations.description: Only this function reads `process.env`. The rest of the module receives ordinary values, which keeps parsing and validation deterministic.

annotations.title: Validate before constructing trusted config
annotations.description: The default is applied before validation. Callers can therefore rely on the returned port already satisfying the runtime constraint.

annotations.title: This function forms the trusted configuration boundary
annotations.description: After this range returns, downstream code should consume `AppConfig` instead of reading environment variables again.
